mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp does not correlate with subsequent earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend during periods of RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annualized increase of more than 3% over the previous month, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, the combination signals a strong labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decrease does not correlate with subsequent earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous two months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decrease > 10% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: When Real GDP (GDPC1) shows a quarter-over-quarter decline and Industrial Production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% over the previous month, the combination signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ decline and INDPRO decrease > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of GDPC1 decline and INDPRO decrease does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.
